## This repository does not accept pull requests

This is assignment material. Pull requests opened here are closed
automatically and are **not** part of any submission — we will not see it as
your work.

**Submit by email**, as the assignment says:

> `talent.acquisition@simplifymoney.in`

Build your app in **your own repository**, not here.

Found a genuine problem with the mock server or the data — it won't start, a
